title: 70 Arrests under the Important Heads of Crimes of IPC The break-up of the number of persons arrested during 1972 under the important heads of IPC crimes revealed that the highest number of arrests was in respect of riot which constituted 31.3% of the total number of arrests. This very head indicated the highest percentage increase of 17.8% over 1971. Variations for other heads of crimes varied from as low as 0.4% in case of murder and as high as 17.8% in case of riots. The relevant statistics are presented in Table-20.
